candidate_consistent_protection: Use a common S/H transfer eligibility gate on the same reconstructed Born flavour/x/emission scale. If required native daughter density is nonpositive, retain both S and negativeH without attempting the ordinary PDF ratio. Do not discard or retry the event; do not patch Pythia.
cause: The native daughter charm xf is zero at the emission scale; g/c shower PDF ratio is infinite while the hard-scale ratio is finite.
details: Independent LHAPDF probe identifies a negative raw charm density clipped to zero by Pythia. This is just above the forced-conversion threshold; the native ordinary branch uses a tiny-PDF denominator floor. Its support depends on x and is not represented by the unfloored ordinary PDF-ratio/Sudakov model.
limits: The conservative paired transfer gate does not supply the native floored-PDF density. A separate normalization and matching treatment would be needed to remove negative H weights in this component.
